results.name: Dumbbells Triceps Kick Back Both Arms
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at your hips and lower your upper body to almost parallel to the floor.
Bend your elbows to bring the dumbbells close to your torso, with your upper arms parallel to the floor and your forearms perpendicular to the floor.
Extend your arms fully behind you by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary. Squeeze your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly return the dumbbells to the starting position by bending your elbows. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid swinging the weights; use only your triceps to perform the movement.
Focus on a slow and controlled movement to maximize triceps engagement.
Exhale as you extend your arms and inhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Dumbbells Triceps Kick Back Both Arms is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: EZ Bar Overhead Extensions Standing
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip. Raise the bar overhead until your arms are fully extended, with your hands positioned closer together on the bar.
Keep your elbows close to your head and slowly lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
Lower the bar until your arms are fully bent.
Extend your elbows to raise the bar back to the starting position, fully extending your arms overhead.
tips: Ensure your elbows remain close to your head throughout the movement to effectively target the triceps.
Use a controlled motion and avoid swinging the bar or using momentum.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension on the triceps.
results.description: EZ Bar Overhead Extensions Standing is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with an ez barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Floor Tricep Dip
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your heels planted in front of you with your toes pointing upward. Place both hands behind your hips with your palms flat, your fingers pointing toward your feet, and your elbows slightly bent.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips slightly above the floor, keeping your chest raised and your shoulders pulled back.
Press firmly through your palms and extend your elbows to lift your hips. Pause at the top, while squeezing your triceps.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips, returning to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Point your elbows backward instead of allowing them to flare outward.
Move through your elbows rather than dropping and raising your hips alone.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging them toward your ears.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you press upward.
results.description: Floor Tricep Dip is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Chest, Forearms.

results.name: Incline Diamond Push Up on Bench
instructions: Position yourself facing a bench. Place your hands on the edge of the bench close together so that your thumbs and index fingers form a diamond shape.
Step your feet back to extend your legs fully, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core to maintain stability.
Lower your chest towards the bench by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
Avoid flaring your elbows out to the sides; keep them close to your body to engage your triceps more effectively.
Use a stable, non-slip bench to prevent any movement or slipping during the exercise.
results.description: Incline Diamond Push Up on Bench is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Incline Push Ups on Chair
instructions: Stand facing a chair and place your hands on top, close to the edge, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Step your feet back to extend your legs behind you, forming a straight line from your head to your heels.
Engage your core and keep your body straight. Lower your chest towards the chair by bending your elbows, keeping them at a 45-degree angle to your body.
Lower yourself until your chest is close to the chair, then push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower yourself down.
Use a chair that can support your weight without moving.
Keep your core engaged to maintain a straight body line and avoid sagging your hips.
results.description: Incline Push Ups on Chair is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips and hold a kettlebell above your chest with both hands using a neutral grip.
Keep your hips raised as you bend your elbows and lower the kettlebell toward your forehead, stopping just above it with control.
Extend your elbows and raise the kettlebell back above your chest.
Repeat the movement while maintaining the bridge position, for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain your hips in a raised and level position.
Keep your elbows close together as you lower the weight.
Avoid arching your lower back as you hold the bridge.
Inhale as you lower the kettlebell and exhale as you extend your elbows.
results.description: Kettlebell Decline Skull Crusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms, Glutes.

results.name: Kettlebell Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with straight arms.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the kettlebell toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to return and repeat.
tips: Point your elbows to the ceiling.
Lower slowly.
results.description: Kettlebell Skull Crusher is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand tall holding a kettlebell by the horns overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the kettlebell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms to lift it back up and repeat.
tips: Brace your core to avoid arching your back.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
results.description: Kettlebell Standing Tricep Extension is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Lie on your back with your head near the landmine and hold the end of the bar above your face with both hands.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms to press it back up and repeat.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing up.
Control the lowering.
results.description: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch (Front View)
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise your right arm overhead and bend your elbow, reaching your right hand down towards your upper back.
Bring your left arm overhead and hold your right elbow with your left hand, gently pulling your right elbow to the left side to deepen the stretch. Hold this position for 15-30 seconds.

Release the stretch and return to the starting position. Repeat on the left side by raising your left arm overhead and bending your elbow, using your right hand to assist with the stretch. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid arching your back; keep your spine neutral to maximize the stretch and prevent injury.
Keep your core engaged to maintain balance and support your lower back.
Use gentle pressure when pulling on your elbow to avoid overstretching and potential discomfort.
results.description: Overhead Triceps Stretch (Front View) is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the triceps (upper arms). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.
